## Wave 6 Summary

This wave discharges the five methodology / K-counter / audit-script / regulator-retrofit carry-forwards surfaced by the dual-source (session-93 + session-x) carry-forward grab. It is the framework-hygiene wave: no new substrate-physics number is computed; every gate either extends an audit script, advances or assesses a methodology-rule K-counter, synthesizes a non-promotion meta-taxonomy, or retrofits a grandfathered legacy artifact. **Four of the five gates are METHODOLOGY-class** (M1∧M2∧M3∧M4 strict conjunction per `wave-classification.md`); item 20 is INFO-class methodology synthesis that lands as a METHODOLOGY-class artifact-existence verdict. The carry-forward sources are: CF-S94-W1-C (item 17, `session-93-w1-workingpaper.md:258` / `session-93-housekeeping.md:115`); CF-S94-MULT-NORM-CANCELLATION-K3 (item 18, `session-93-w3-workingpaper.md:615` / `hk:126`); CF-S94-S1-SINGLET-AREA (item 19, `hk:137`); CF-S94-NON-PROMOTION-META-TAXONOMY (item 20, `hk:148`); CF-SX-1 (item 21, `session-x-w9-workingpaper.md:257`).

**Direction-of-explanation discipline** (`phononic-framing.md`): this wave operates at the methodology-floor F-image layer per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Layer-Decomposition"`. The substrate-physics observables (D_K eigenvalues, spectral-support weights, area-Casimir functionals, Seeley-DeWitt coefficients) are logically prior; the rule-files, audit scripts, and K-counters are their F-images at the methodology layer. Every gate's substrate_framing block flows FROM the D_K spectral content TOWARD the methodology artifact, never the reverse. None of these gates treats GR / QFT as a container.

```yaml
# ---- Identity (4 fields) ----
gate_id: "S94-CPB-AUDIT-PENDING-VS-DEFECTIVE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[AUDIT]"
classification: "NON-PHONONIC"          # methodology-floor F-image; audit-script structural extension
agent_type: "gen-physicist"
hypothesis: "Extending _cross_pillar_bridge_audit.run_audit() to classify each non-PASS §VII bridge section as pending-candidate (STAGE-1/STAGE-0/PENDING) vs complete-but-defective, and resolving parent/sub-section anatomy inheritance, makes run_audit() return PASS-WITH-N-PENDING (not blanket FAIL) when every non-PASS section is legitimately-pending; after OE-form/tier-marker retrofit of only the genuinely-defective entries, the genuinely-defective count is 0."

method:
  description: >
    Extend run_audit() (currently line 635-684; returns blanket verdict='PASS'|'FAIL'
    at line 680 via all_pass = all(s['verdict']=='PASS')). Add a section-status
    classifier that, for each non-PASS section: (a) detects pending-candidate
    status tags (STAGE-1-CANDIDATE / STAGE-0 / deferred-pending sub-class via the
    existing detect_deferred_pending_sub_class() at line 234, or explicit PENDING
    markers) → class 'legitimately-pending'; (b) resolves parent/sub-section
    anatomy inheritance — a §VII.X.OP-PROJ sub-section that inherits its 5-anatomy
    + 3-level block from a parent §VII.X is NOT independently defective if the
    parent supplies the missing elements (walk the parent anchor, merge inherited
    elements before scoring missing_anatomy_elements / missing_tiers); (c)
    everything else (non-PASS, non-pending, no inherited completion) → class
    'genuinely-defective'. run_audit() returns verdict='PASS-WITH-N-PENDING'
    (N = count of legitimately-pending) when genuinely-defective == 0, else
    'FAIL' with the genuinely-defective list. Retrofit OE-form (Element-2 OE-form
    per cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Element 2 OE-form discipline") and tier
    markers ONLY for the genuinely-defective entries (mack-cosmic-bridge is the
    sole registry writer per feedback_mack-bridge-role.md; this gate flags the
    defective set + retrofit content, the registry edit is mack's). After the
    retrofit set is identified and the audit re-run logic is in place,
    genuinely-defective == 0.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/_cross_pillar_bridge_audit.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set + integer-count + structural-classification"
  form: >
    run_audit() returns verdict ∈ {PASS, PASS-WITH-N-PENDING, FAIL};
    PASS-WITH-N-PENDING iff (genuinely_defective_count == 0 AND
    legitimately_pending_count > 0); FAIL iff genuinely_defective_count > 0;
    PASS iff (genuinely_defective_count == 0 AND legitimately_pending_count == 0).
    Self-test asserts genuinely_defective_count == 0 after retrofit-set identification.

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "genuinely_defective_count == 0  AND  run_audit() emits a non-FAIL verdict-string (PASS or PASS-WITH-N-PENDING)  AND  the classifier distinguishes >=3 status classes {legitimately-pending, genuinely-defective, PASS}  AND  parent/sub-section anatomy-inheritance resolver present (detectable by self-test on a known OP-PROJ inheritor)"
  direction: "="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "Artifact-existence predicate (M1): genuinely-defective is an integer count over registry §VII sections; the boundary == 0 is reached by retrofitting exactly the entries that lack OE-form/tier markers AND are non-pending AND do not inherit completion from a parent. No numerical threshold; the count is decidable by section-text scan + parent-anchor walk."

# (4) reachable_rationals

  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "integer section-counts (genuinely-defective ∈ {0,1,2,...}); discrete"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "N/A — single audit pass over permanent-results-registry.md §VII sections"
  L_max: "N/A — methodology-floor audit; no spectral truncation"
  scan_range: "N/A — registry section enumeration, not a parameter scan"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "N/A — integer-exact section classification (no float comparison)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "registry", "pinmap"]   # script diff + registry text + input-pin map
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]                       # the _cross_pillar_bridge_audit.py diff (METHODOLOGY F-image of the numerical PASS-predicate)

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  run_audit() now classifies non-PASS §VII bridge sections into legitimately-pending
  vs genuinely-defective, resolves parent/sub-section anatomy inheritance, and
  returns PASS-WITH-N-PENDING when all non-PASS are legitimately-pending; after
  retrofitting OE-form/tier markers for the genuinely-defective set, genuinely-defective
  == 0. The audit no longer blanket-FAILs the registry merely because STAGE-1-CANDIDATE
  / deferred-pending / inheriting-sub-section entries are not yet PASS. Solution-space:
  the cross-pillar bridge audit is now status-aware — it can be a load-bearing plan-freeze
  gate without false-FAILing legitimately-pending registry growth.
FAIL_meaning: >
  After classifier extension + retrofit-set identification, genuinely-defective > 0
  (one or more §VII bridge sections is non-PASS, non-pending, and does not inherit
  completion from a parent, and was NOT retrofitted). Solution-space: a genuine
  anatomy/OE-form defect remains in the registry; the defective entry is named and
  routed to mack-cosmic-bridge for the registry retrofit, and the audit correctly
  FAILs until that lands.
INFO_meaning: >
  The classifier extension lands but the registry has zero non-PASS sections (all PASS),
  so PASS-WITH-N-PENDING is structurally unreachable on the current registry state
  (N=0). The extension is verified by the self-test on synthetic pending + defective
  + inheriting-sub-section fixtures rather than by the live registry. Recorded as INFO
  with the self-test evidence; the extension is forward-load-bearing.

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:
    - "computations/_shared/_cross_pillar_bridge_audit.py (extended in place)"
    - "computations/_shared/s94_w6_cpb_audit_pending_vs_defective_selftest.py"
    - "computations/session-94/s94_cpb_audit_pending_vs_defective.json"
  estimated_time: "0.5 wave-equivalents (~2-3 hours)"

substrate_framing: |
  NON-PHONONIC (methodology-floor F-image). Under epistemic-discipline.md
  §"Layer-Decomposition", the substrate-IS cross-pillar bridge observables (each a
  finite-L spectral-triple pairing on (A_K^{<=L}, H_K^{<=L}, D_K^{<=L}) mapped to a
  laboratory-IN continuum observable via HKR / Connes-Karoubi / K-theory boundary)
  are the substrate-physics layer; run_audit()'s PASS/FAIL predicate is their F-image
  at the audit-floor layer. A bridge entry that is STAGE-1-CANDIDATE or deferred-pending
  is substrate-IS-LEGITIMATE — its substrate-IS structural identity (Level-1) may already
  hold while its empirical realization (Level-2/Level-3) is pending refinement. Blanket-FAILing
  such an entry is the audit-floor analog of a methodology-floor F-image vetoing a substrate-IS
  structural PASS (forbidden per the Level-3 annotation discipline). This gate teaches the
  audit to read substrate-IS pending status correctly, flowing FROM the substrate's
  pending-vs-complete distinction TOWARD the audit verdict — never inverting to treat the
  audit's blanket-FAIL as authoritative over a legitimately-pending substrate-IS entry.

**METHODOLOGY-class 4-tuple** (pre-registered input pin per `wave-classification.md §M1-M4`):

- **M1 (PASS-predicate type) = PASS**. The PASS predicate is artifact-existence-with-substantive-content + integer count (`genuinely_defective_count == 0` AND the classifier emits the new verdict-string AND the inheritance resolver is present), NOT a numerical comparison `value < threshold`. Integer section-counts are explicitly in the M1 family.
- **M2 (producing-operation type) = PASS (with nuance)**. The producing op edits `_cross_pillar_bridge_audit.py` (a `.py` file) + runs it. M2 FORBIDS "ANY `.py` script whose OUTPUT is a numerical comparison against a pre-registered threshold." This audit script's output is a STRUCTURAL classification verdict + integer counts (the same artifact-existence-style predicate M1 governs), NOT a numerical-threshold comparison; the script performs `grep`-style text scans + section-count integers, which M2 explicitly permits. **Nuance honestly disclosed**: the artifact edited is an audit script rather than a `.claude/{rules,templates,skills}/**` file; this is the canonical METHODOLOGY-class audit-script-extension pattern (precedent: S88+ `_*_audit.py` extensions land as METHODOLOGY-class), and M2's intent (no fixture-with-hand-engineered-numerical-targets; no eigenvalue/linear-algebra output) is satisfied.
- **M3 (source-of-truth type) = PASS**. Content derives from the verbatim pre-registered enumeration in `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md` (deferred-pending sub-class taxonomy, OE-form discipline, Tier-1/Tier-2 ladder) + the existing `detect_deferred_pending_sub_class()` machinery. No first-principles new physics derivation.
- **M4 (allowlist membership) = PENDING orchestrator append** (flagged above).

**M2 boundary note**: the genuinely-defective retrofit *content* (OE-form Element-2 expressions, tier markers) is flagged by this gate but the registry edit itself is mack-cosmic-bridge's (sole registry writer per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md`). This gate does NOT write `permanent-results-registry.md`; it writes the audit script + the JSON report naming the defective set.

**METHODOLOGY-class 4-tuple**:

- **M1 = PASS**. PASS predicate is structural-distinctness (categorical) + integer K-counter increment (K=2 → K=3) + rule-file edit existence, NOT a numerical threshold. The `C_2^max`-INVARIANCE check uses an FD-floor tolerance, but that is a re-read confirmation of an ALREADY-recorded structural identity (the gate's verdict turns on the categorical distinctness predicate + the integer increment, not on a new numerical comparison).
- **M2 = PASS (with nuance)**. The producing script re-reads the W3-2 npz (no new diagonalization, no fixture with hand-engineered numerical targets) and the math-scripts.md edit is a rule-file Edit. The re-read confirmation is `grep`/load-and-assert-structural-fingerprint, not an eigenvalue computation whose output is a numerical-threshold comparison. **Nuance**: a tiny confirmation script `.py` is created; its output is a structural-fingerprint boolean + a categorical verdict, which is in the integer/structural M1 family, so M2's "no `.py` whose output is a numerical-threshold comparison" intent holds.
- **M3 = PASS**. Content derives from the verbatim pre-registered K=3-candidate row + DISSENT-sharpened criterion already in `math-scripts.md`, plus the S93 W3-2 closed verdict. No new physics derivation.
- **M4 = PENDING orchestrator append** (flagged above).

**Hybrid-Independence-Test-distinctness criterion (pre-registered)**: per `math-scripts.md §"K-counter advancement criterion (DISSENT-sharpened)"`, K=3 advancement REQUIRES a STRUCTURALLY DISTINCT factorization mechanism. The three categorical axes are: (i) substrate-distance pole; (ii) regulator class; (iii) spectral-support form. The S91 W5-1 (K=1) form is the **L_max-truncation weight**; the S92 W3-6 (K=2) form is the **τ-moduli-deformation weight**; the S93 W3-2 candidate is the **bottom-K Casimir-ceiling weight at fixed m_PV**. These are distinct on axis (iii) spectral-support-form (truncation envelope vs moduli-deformation weight vs Casimir-ceiling-at-fixed-mass weight). The PASS predicate REQUIRES the W3-2 form to be distinct on ≥1 axis AND not be the same pattern at a different parameter value; same-pattern reparametrizations count as ONE instance (FAIL the increment).

  from a methodology-floor F-image. This flows FROM the substrate's structure-vs-number distinction
  TOWARD the methodology meta-taxonomy; it does not invert to let a held NUMBER veto the permanent
  STRUCTURE.

# OUTCOME-1 (UNIFYING-META-RULE-DRAFTED): a single non-promotion meta-taxonomy with
#   shared predicate + 3-way per-member discriminator. Posterior: the three members are

# OUTCOME-2 (THREE-CONFIRMED-ORTHOGONAL): distinct firing sub-tests (Tier-2 fires on

#   substrate-first §(iv-bis)) ⇒ NO MERGE. Posterior: the three stay separate; the synthesis
#   pins the orthogonality so they are never conflated.
# Neither outcome is pre-judged. The synthesis derives which holds from the rule/corpus text.
```

**METHODOLOGY-class 4-tuple**:

- **M1 = PASS**. PASS predicate is artifact-existence-with-substantive-content (the synthesis section present with ≥15 substantive lines reaching a definite UNIFYING or ORTHOGONAL outcome), NOT a numerical comparison.
- **M2 = PASS (with nuance)**. The producing op is a synthesis + (optional) rule/corpus `.md` Edit. The assessment script's output is a categorical outcome (UNIFYING/ORTHOGONAL) + a member table, NOT a numerical-threshold comparison; no eigenvalue computation, no fixture. **Nuance**: a small synthesis-record `.py` emits the JSON + verdict line.
- **M3 = PASS**. Content derives from the verbatim closed corpus §25 + §11.1 + the two parent rules. No new physics; the three member verdicts are already proven/landed.
- **M4 = PENDING orchestrator append** (flagged above).

**Note on the composite verdict** (`gate-verdicts.md`): this is an INFO-class gate by design — the canonical top-line verdict is INFO regardless of which outcome (UNIFYING vs ORTHOGONAL) the synthesis reaches, with the chosen outcome recorded in the `value=` field. PASS/FAIL in the rubric describe the synthesis QUALITY, not the top-line. Both outcomes are pre-registered above; neither is pre-judged (no iterate-until-a-particular-outcome framing, per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Dual-prior pre-registration as track-discriminator"`).
